interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; DUAS retas numéricas de 0 a 1, uma para cada quantidade (rotuladas "Weight of Katie's cheese" e "Weight of Franklin's cheese"); para cada reta há um campo onde o aluno digita em quantas partes iguais dividi-la (com confirmação) e, depois, marca o ponto da fração correspondente; abaixo, um seletor em que o aluno escolhe UMA destas alternativas: "Yes; the piece of cheese Katie brought is heavier."; "No. Katie is not right. dicas.texto: Which number in a fraction tells how many equal parts make the whole?

Click the second division point on the line divided into fifths.

exercicio.statement:
Katie and Franklin each brought a piece of cheese to the school picnic. Katie and Franklin brought different types of cheese so it looks like they brought the same amount, but not necessarily the same weight. Katie claims that her cheese is heavier. Is this true?
Katie's cheese weighs 2/5 of a pound.
Franklin's cheese weighs 2/3 of a pound.
Is Katie right?
